items.title: 1. Gas Particles are in Constant, Random Motion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 1. Gas Particles are in Constant, Random Motion: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas ke molecules hamesha random motion mein rehte hain. Woh seedhi lines mein chalte hain jab tak kisi doosre molecule ya bartan (container) ki deewar se takra na jayein.
